prompt: Copper paints the fence bright yellow
title: Bright Yellow Fence
irony: Copper paints the fence bright yellow for next year's buyers, but its glow makes the whole street stop and enjoy today.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning sun hits the gray street fence as Copper lifts a bright yellow paint can.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green clutches his paint-facts book and wants a neat job while Copper dreams aloud about next year's buyers.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black scoffs that yellow drips and dares Jade to brush first before the hot sun dries the paint.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The friends slap yellow paint on the fence and chant the bright hook together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Copper runs late for tape and Green over-worries each drip while Jade slaps paint too fast.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Yellow hands, yellow noses and a wobbly ladder end with Copper sitting in the yellow puddle.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The street keeps rolling yellow paint up the fence and sings the hook again.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Copper stops with his dripping brush and sees the kids glowing brighter than any sold house.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Copper chooses today over next year and hands Green the brush to paint together.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The crew sings the hook while Copper turns the last line: the fence shines for today.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The yellow fence glows as neighbors gather on the sunny street to share cold juice.
